_doc: Declarative backend role binding for OT SPI_HOST. irq + pin_io reproduce the auto-detector byte-for-byte (irq from bindings/spi_host.digest.json irq_suggestion; pin_io = the cio_sd_o/cio_sd_en_o/cio_sd_i triple the detector reports). `spi_master` is the SPI-master bridge organ: the model drives sck/csb/sd; the shim watches every model clock and bridges the bit stream to a QEMU SSI bus (`spi<bus-num>`, m25p80-class flash attaches via the board's spiflash0 property).

spi_master._doc: SPI master bridge for the QP shim: model-driven serial clock / chip-select / data lanes -> QEMU SSI bus. MOSI = lane 0 of cio_sd_o (enable lane 0 of cio_sd_en_o), MISO = lane 1 of cio_sd_i. Mode (CPOL/CPHA) is inferred from the pins per transaction; byte direction from the MOSI output enable.
